labels.label: none
labels.definition: No actionable disaster impact is supported by the available evidence.

labels.label: low
labels.definition: Localized or low-consequence impact is supported, with limited operational disruption.

labels.label: medium
labels.definition: Material impact is present and likely requires follow-up verification or moderate intervention.

labels.label: high
labels.definition: Substantial impact is supported by evidence and should trigger urgent analyst attention.

labels.label: critical
labels.definition: Severe, high-risk impact is supported by evidence and should trigger immediate escalation.

adjudication_policy.rule: Resolve hidden-test label disagreements before task release.
